title: Sunday Recovery Walk · October 18
note: Sunday, October 18 · Recovery day after only 3 hours of sleep and three glasses of wine last night. Optional gentle walk if alert, steady, and feeling well. No jogging, power-walking intervals, heavy strength, or strenuous core work today. Hydrate normally, eat, and prioritize sleep tonight. Skip exercise if dizzy, unusually fatigued, unsteady, or experiencing palpitations. Stop for chest pain or other concerning symptoms.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Start slowly. Only continue if you feel alert and steady.

items.name: Comfortable walk
items.instructions: Easy conversational pace; slow down whenever needed.

items.name: Cool-down
items.instructions: Gradually ease down and stop if you feel lightheaded.

items.name: Gentle shoulder rolls and arm circles
Easy side-to-side weight shifts
items.instructions: Use support if balance feels off.

items.name: Relaxed standing breathing and light stretching
items.instructions: Keep breathing naturally; skip if you feel unwell.
